findings.finding: An at-the-market facility with Roth Capital for up to $4,353,000 of common stock, dated 2026-08-13 and sold off the S-3 declared effective on 2026-07-01, is open and can sell into the 2026-09-25 session. The issuer is plainly short of cash: on 2026-08-26 it took $1.15M of 10% unsecured demand notes from NLabs, an affiliate of the CEO, for working capital.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM sells continuously in the market during regular hours, so any bounce on 2026-09-25 can be met by issuer supply the same day. Here $4.35M of capacity sits against a market cap of about $9-13M, so it is large relative to the float. No new prospectus supplement is needed for each draw, so the selling is invisible until the next 10-Q.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ATM has been open since 2026-08-13. Since the 09-15 spike this name has closed lower on 5 of 6 comparable-drop days (09-17 -16.51, 09-18 -18.43, 09-21 -1.10, 09-23 -6.21 next close), which fits steady supply but does not prove ATM use.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's price reflects the unwind of the merger spike. It does not reflect the issuer as a price-insensitive seller tomorrow, because nobody can see ATM draws until they are disclosed. If the market were holding that supply, bounces would already be failing intraday on rising volume; instead today traded below normal volume.
findings.independence: The 2026-08-26 8-K shows $1.15M of CEO-affiliate demand notes taken for working capital, which is a motive to sell stock at any price: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1840317/000121390026093996/ea0303433-8k_veea.htm

outside_window.finding: A definitive NovaGen business combination agreement, targeted 'within the coming weeks' with no date. It is a binary upside catalyst for a name whose spike has mostly unwound.

Nasdaq independent-director and committee deficiency (Rules 5605(b)(1), (c)(2)(A), (d)(2)(A)). The cure deadline is the earlier of the next annual meeting or 2027-05-31, and 2026-11-27 if the meeting is held before that date.
The NLabs demand notes ($1.15M at 10%) mature on 2026-12-31 or earlier on demand, adding liquidity pressure.
Next 10-Q (Zacks cadence estimate 2026-11-13, not company-announced). It would reveal ATM usage around the spike.
